name: Wright Flyer powered flight
description: The Wrights’ 1903 Flyer combined propulsion and pilot-controlled surfaces in a piloted heavier-than-air aircraft; this complete aircraft is distinct from its aluminum engine-body material.

date.basis: The cited account dates this scoped episode.

events.statement: Orville Wright piloted the powered 1903 Flyer at Kitty Hawk, flying 120 feet in 12 seconds; three further flights followed.
events.caveats: A brief experimental flight is not evidence of commercial transport or later aircraft performance.
